description: Defines the UserRole entity class with ORM mapping, representing user roles with properties like id, name, displayName, isAssignable, and isPredefined in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: Entity class representing a user role with properties and ORM mapping annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user role.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user role.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user role.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the user role.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the user role.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the user role.

methods.name: isAssignable
methods.description: Checks if the user role is assignable.

methods.name: setIsAssignable
methods.description: Sets whether the user role is assignable.

methods.name: isPredefined
methods.description: Checks if the user role is predefined.

methods.name: setIsPredefined
methods.description: Sets whether the user role is predefined.
